name: Suzuki GSX-S750 / GSX-S1000
engine: 749 or 999 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: Suzuki's naked GSX-R based fours. A few small recalls on early and late bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2016 GSX-S1000s are in recall 15V788 (front brake calipers). 2018 GSX-S750s are in recall 18V694 (fuel pump o-ring). 2020 and 2024 GSX-S1000S Katanas are in recall 25V505 (headlight).

recalls.what: Front brake calipers may leak brake fluid.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the front calipers free.

recalls.what: Fuel pump o-ring may be twisted and leak fuel.
Headlight upper beam is too bright to meet the lighting standard.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the headlight assembly free.
